uniform_rules.statement: At decision instant t, let x be the owner value of the input's quantity at its latest observation D visible at t (the owners' latest-available convention). H is the owner values of the same quantity at the prior observations D' of its native series with D - 730 days <= D' < D, computed from the same point-in-time inputs; incomplete (None) values are skipped, never filled. z = (x - mean(H)) / sd(H) with the population standard deviation (ddof 0). z is None when x is None, when len(H) < 30, or when every value of H is exactly equal (zero variance; the refusal does not depend on float rounding). Otherwise z is computed by the BTC-041 helper. Nothing is zero-filled; None leaves the consuming owner's incomplete result standing.
